'''The Gaping Chasm''' is one of the minor [[silithid]] [[Silithid#Hives|hives]] found in southeastern [[Tanaris]]. The area is swarming with Hazzali silithid and has several large hive complexes within.

==History==
[[Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser]] sent [[Junior Surveyor Scrimshank]] to Gaping Chasm, but he went missing. He died in the area, and his gear was recovered by [[adventurer]]s and returned to Fizzledowser.
